text: 下面进入口袋 01 · 小作文 8 句极简骨架与格式红线卡，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【句型提取 · 书信礼貌建议】不要写 I think you should extend hours，用形式主语与挂载改写：
It would be deeply appreciated if the library could extend its opening hours, which would greatly facilitate daily study.
手术刀：It would be deeply appreciated if 接逗号 which 挂载结果。
【句型提取 · Notice 物称】不要写 We will hold，请用活动与队伍作主语：
The Student Union is scheduled to host a singing contest, and each team is expected to consist of three to five students.
手术刀：is scheduled to host 与 consist of 搭配，记住 consist of 无被动。
【句型提取 · 投诉与致歉】用形式宾语虚拟督促整改，并写出客观致歉原因：
I deem it imperative that prompt measures be taken to rectify this issue, and my tight schedule prevented me from attending on time.
手术刀：deem it imperative that 接原形 be taken；道歉保留 I sincerely apologize。
